spec.title: Packets per second (PPS)
spec.description: Packets per second received by a specific target host.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  TIME_BUCKET AS time,
  DSTADDR AS metric,
  TOTAL_DPKTS / (greatest(1, EXACT_END - EXACT_START) / 1000) AS value
FROM chiba.host_dst_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
  AND DSTADDR IN (
    SELECT DSTADDR
    FROM chiba.host_dst_view
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
    GROUP BY DSTADDR
    ORDER BY sum(TOTAL_DPKTS) DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
ORDER BY time;

spec.title: DDoS Targets
spec.description: Count of destination hosts receiving traffic concurrently from an abnormal number of distinct sources.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT DSTADDR) AS active_ddos_targets
FROM chiba.host_dst_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
  AND UNIQUE_SRCADDR >= 50;

spec.title: Network Scanners
spec.description: Count of source hosts transmitting traffic to an abnormal number of distinct destinations.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT SRCADDR) AS active_scanners
FROM chiba.host_src_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
  AND UNIQUE_DSTADDR >= 50;

spec.title: Port Scanners
spec.description: Count of originating source hosts probing an abnormal number of distinct destination ports.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT SRCADDR) AS active_port_scanners
FROM chiba.host_src_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
  AND UNIQUE_DSTPORT >= 20;

spec.title: High Egress Anomalies
spec.description: Count of source hosts emitting cumulative data volume exceeding the defined threshold.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT SRCADDR) AS exfil_candidates
FROM chiba.host_src_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
  AND TOTAL_DOCTETS >= 20971520;

spec.title: Real-Time Incidents (1m)
spec.description: Detection of rapid DDoS floods, network and port scans, data exfiltration occurring within a minute.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    max(TIME_BUCKET) AS "Last Seen",
    DSTADDR AS "Host IP",
    'Target (Inbound)' AS "Entity Role",
    'Distributed Flood' AS "Anomaly Type",
    multiIf(max(UNIQUE_SRCADDR) >= 200, 'CRITICAL', 'WARNING') AS "Severity",
    concat(toString(max(UNIQUE_SRCADDR)), ' Peak Sources (', toString(count()), ' min active)') AS "Observed Metric"
FROM chiba.host_dst_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
  AND UNIQUE_SRCADDR >= 50
GROUP BY DSTADDR
  
UNION ALL

SELECT
  max(TIME_BUCKET) AS "Last Seen",
  SRCADDR AS "Host IP",
  'Originator (Outbound)' AS "Entity Role",
  'Horizontal Network Sweep' AS "Anomaly Type",
  multiIf(max(UNIQUE_DSTADDR) >= 200, 'CRITICAL', 'WARNING') AS "Severity",
  concat(toString(max(UNIQUE_DSTADDR)), ' Peak Targets (', toString(count()), ' min active)') AS "Observed Metric"
  FROM chiba.host_src_view
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
    AND UNIQUE_DSTADDR >= 50
  GROUP BY SRCADDR
  UNION ALL

SELECT
  max(TIME_BUCKET) AS "Last Seen",
  SRCADDR AS "Host IP",
  'Originator (Outbound)' AS "Entity Role",
  'Vertical Port Scan' AS "Anomaly Type",
  multiIf(max(UNIQUE_DSTPORT) >= 100, 'CRITICAL', 'WARNING') AS "Severity",
  concat(toString(max(UNIQUE_DSTPORT)), ' Peak Ports (', toString(count()), ' min active)') AS "Observed Metric"
FROM chiba.host_src_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
  AND UNIQUE_DSTPORT >= 20
GROUP BY SRCADDR
  
UNION ALL
  
SELECT
  max(TIME_BUCKET) AS "Last Seen",
  SRCADDR AS "Host IP",
  'Originator (Outbound)' AS "Entity Role",
  'Excessive Outbound Volume' AS "Anomaly Type",
  multiIf(max(TOTAL_DOCTETS) >= 52428800, 'CRITICAL', 'WARNING') AS "Severity",
  concat(formatReadableSize(max(TOTAL_DOCTETS)), ' Peak/min (', toString(count()), ' min active)') AS "Observed Metric"
FROM chiba.host_src_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
  AND TOTAL_DOCTETS >= 20971520
GROUP BY SRCADDR
ORDER BY "Last Seen" DESC
LIMIT 50;

spec.title: Slow Scanners
spec.description: Detection of slow port scanners within a 24-hour window.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  SRCADDR AS "Source Host",
  UNIQUE_DSTPORT AS "Probed Ports (24h)",
  UNIQUE_DSTADDR AS "Probed Targets (24h)",
  PORTS_PER_HOUR AS "Rate (Ports/h)",
  ACTIVE_SPAN_MINUTES AS "Duration (min)",
  TOTAL_DOCTETS AS "Total Volume",
  toDateTime(EXACT_START) AS "First Seen",
  toDateTime(EXACT_END) AS "Last Seen"
FROM chiba.slow_scanners_view
ORDER BY "Probed Ports (24h)" DESC
LIMIT 15;

spec.title: Packets per second (PPS)
spec.description: Packets per second emitted by a specific source host.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  TIME_BUCKET AS time,
  SRCADDR AS metric,
  TOTAL_DPKTS / (greatest(1, EXACT_END - EXACT_START) / 1000) AS value
FROM chiba.host_src_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
  AND SRCADDR IN (
    SELECT SRCADDR
    FROM chiba.host_src_view
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
    GROUP BY SRCADDR
    ORDER BY sum(TOTAL_DPKTS) DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
ORDER BY time;

spec.title: Bits per second (BPS)
spec.description: Bits per second received by a specific target host.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  TIME_BUCKET AS time,
  DSTADDR AS metric,
  (sum(TOTAL_DOCTETS) * 8) / $__interval_s AS value
FROM chiba.host_dst_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
  AND DSTADDR IN (
    SELECT DSTADDR
    FROM chiba.host_dst_view
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
    GROUP BY DSTADDR
    ORDER BY sum(TOTAL_DOCTETS) DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  DSTADDR AS "Target Host",
  sum(TOTAL_DOCTETS) AS "Total Volume",
  sum(TOTAL_DPKTS) AS "Total Packets",
  max(UNIQUE_SRCADDR) AS "Peak Attackers"
FROM chiba.host_dst_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
GROUP BY "Target Host"
ORDER BY "Total Volume" DESC
LIMIT 10;

spec.title: Bits per second (BPS)
spec.description: Bits per second emitted by a specific source host.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  TIME_BUCKET AS time,
  SRCADDR AS metric,
  (sum(TOTAL_DOCTETS) * 8) / $__interval_s AS value
FROM chiba.host_src_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
  AND SRCADDR IN (
    SELECT SRCADDR
    FROM chiba.host_src_view
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
    GROUP BY SRCADDR 
    ORDER BY sum(TOTAL_DOCTETS) DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  SRCADDR AS "Source Host",
  sum(TOTAL_DOCTETS) AS "Total Volume",
  sum(TOTAL_DPKTS) AS "Total Packets",
  max(UNIQUE_DSTADDR) AS "Unique Destinations",
  max(UNIQUE_DSTPORT) AS "Targeted Ports"
FROM chiba.host_src_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
GROUP BY "Source Host"
ORDER BY "Total Volume" DESC
LIMIT 10;

spec.title: L4 Protocol Share
spec.description: Shows the overall network traffic by IP Protocol.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(PROT) as protocol,
  sum(TOTAL_DOCTETS) AS volume
FROM chiba.service_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
GROUP BY PROT
ORDER BY volume DESC;

spec.title: Top Active Services / Ports
spec.description: Visualizes which destination ports/services are consuming the most traffic.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(DSTPORT) AS port,
  sum(TOTAL_DOCTETS) AS volume
FROM chiba.service_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
 AND DSTPORT > 0
GROUP BY port
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 10;

spec.title: Protocol Volume Over Time
spec.description: Evolution of network volume across IP protocols over the selected time interval.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  TIME_BUCKET AS time,
  toString(PROT) AS metric,
  sum(TOTAL_DOCTETS) AS value
FROM chiba.service_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIME_BUCKET)
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time;
